## What was tried
This is item C19 of the coordinator issue #716 (next release: the features of issue 655 that the current plan does not cover), split out so it can be built and tracked on its own. Issue 655 was split into its 14 sections and one analyst per section classified every design feature against the unification spec and its decision record; this item is one of the features that were found missing. Nothing in this item is built yet. #716 stays the umbrella issue: its closing review holds the build order, the phases and the open owner decisions.

## Relevant files and links
- Parent issue: #716 (this item is a sub-issue of it). Sister issues of the split: watcher #717, TUI dashboard #718. Source design: #655.
- Current plan (local files, not pushed): `.dev/brainstorms/20261120-pr686-unify/spec/SPEC.md` (stages S0 to S17, Appendix B after PR 700), `.dev/brainstorms/20261120-pr686-unify/DECISIONS.md` (43 recorded decisions), `.dev/brainstorms/20261120-pr686-unify/debates/*/VERDICT.md`, `.dev/brainstorms/20261120-pr686-unify/spec/FOLLOW-UPS.md`.
- Per-section analysis with every row, status and evidence (local files, not pushed): `.dev/implement/reference-our-research-a-3463b8ef/sections/section-01.md` to `section-14.md`.
- Pull request 697 (closed unmerged revert of PR 682, replaced after PR 700 by PR 701) and the follow-up issues 698 and 699 come from the same review work.

## Done when
The item below is built, tested and checked against its own lines, or the owner records in chat that it is dropped. The text is copied unchanged from #716.

### C19. Settle each worker at the end: release or retain its terminal (655 section 2; rows S02-F54)
  - What to build: After a worker's `worker_done` is handled, the coordinator releases (or deliberately retains) that worker's terminal and checks that `worker-list --run <id> --terminal-state reclaimable` is empty.
  - Done when: a finished fixture run ends with no terminal in state `reclaimable` for the Run, or with a recorded reason for each retained one.
  - Related items (read together; the order is in the review at the end): C5, C11
  - Research and debate results from our documents:
    - S02-F54: .dev/brainstorms/20261120-pr686-unify/spec/SPEC.md:762 `Issues 698 (release-worker guard bypass and approver rule)`; memory note orca-coordinator-rebind-after-resume.md:10 (a closed terminal returns its Task to `ready`). Local check: `worker-release`, `worker-retain` and `worker-list --terminal-state reclaimable` exist (help output).
  - Watch out:
    - S02-F54: name clash: Orca's `worker-release` (terminal accounting) and the plan's `release-worker` verb (guard approval file) must not be confused; the coordinator never runs `worker-stop` or `worker-abandon` (655 section 9, consistent with "never interrupt" FR-40).


## Pick-up note
- Read the review at the end of #716 first: it holds the build order, the three phases and the owner decisions that gate this item. The related-item ids above (C numbers) refer to the sibling sub-issues of #716.
- The plan files named above are local files, not pushed; read them from a checkout that has them, or ask the owner.
title: [FEATURE] Coordinator C19: Settle each worker at the end: release or retain its terminal
